hooks.prompt:
The user submitted a message. Check if they are asking to merge, mark ready for review, push code, or reporting a merge happened. Remind of the workflow:

1. Grill 2. Issue 3. Triage 4. Spec (on issue) 5. Draft PR (assign user) 6. Plan (on PR) 7. Implement 8. Post-impl review (ponytail + improve + docs eval — explore findings before acting) 9. Preflight + rebase 10. Present to user — STOP and wait for merge authorization 11. Merge: USER ONLY via ! gh pr merge (gh pr merge is denied)

Post-merge tasks: debrief if diverged (comment + label), verify issue triage labels, clean worktrees, update memory.

CRITICAL: Claude CANNOT merge. gh pr merge is denied by permissions. The user merges manually. Claude presents the PR status and waits.

Return {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"<relevant reminder>"}} if workflow steps apply, or {} if not relevant.
